description:
Who We Are:

We are a passionate and driven group of tech enthusiasts, space nerds, and problem-solvers participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge – Calicut Local Event. 

Why Join Our Team?

Joining us means joining a collaborative, ego-free, and high-energy environment where every idea is heard. We aren't just here to code under pressure; we're here to learn, experiment, build something we are genuinely proud of, and have fun doing it.
